findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the sanitizer bucket at a concentration of 100 ppm quaternary ammonia. CORRECTED- the person in charge (PIC) added 2 capfuls of sanitizer, and the sanitizer was observed at 200 ppm. Ensure sanitizer used for food contact surfaces is made and tested at a frequency to meet the required concentration as required by the manufacterer's label.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (C) A quaternary ammonium compound solution shall: (1) Have a minimum temperature of 24°C (75°F), (2) Have a concentration as specified under § 7-204.11 and as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling, and (3) Be used only in water with 500 MG/L hardness or less or in water having a hardness no greater than specified by the EPA-registered label use instructions. [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed no sanitizer present at the start of the inspection. CORRECTED- person in charge (PIC) made sanitizer at triple sink. Ensure sanitizer solution is available and holding the correct concentration (with facility’s test strips) during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-501.114(C) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. [P]

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: Inspector observed debris accumulation on the soda nozzle at the bar. CORRECTED- PIC removed nozzle to be cleaned and sanitized. Ensure food contact surfaces are cleaned at a frequency to prevent the build up of soil or debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. [Pf]
